events.text: I'm sixth in line, so I can't act this row; only Eli is at risk. Weak panes so far: R,R,L,L,L,L,R. Staying quiet preserves my position and keeps my forge power unspent for later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 7 was weak right, so row 8 is unknown. Eli leads; let others take risks. I'll wait and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 8 final, Eli front. Weak panes: row1 R,2 R,3 L,4 L,5 L,6 L,7 R. No clear pattern. Eli likely dies or survives, irrelevant to me as I'm back. My useless power, Cole maybe survives fall from chalk. Stay silent, conserve.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli, and I know the safe side for each row. The current row is 8. My private knowledge says row 8 safe side is L. The public log and whispers are trying to influence my decision, but my private knowledge is absolute for this stage. Ash whispered to step left, which matches m

events.name: Eli
events.text: Left.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am third in line, so Eli (front) and Ash (second) must survive to get me to the front for row 8. If they both step on weak panes and die, I still advance automatically but lose my swap power's value since the game ends immediately after row 8 anyway? No, wait. If they die, I be

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm 5th in line and can only wait this round. Row 8's weak pane is unknown even to me. No leverage to gain by talking; stay quiet and hope someone ahead breaks wrong and thins the field.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is at the front and has to make the decision for this row. I should analyze the given information to understand the pattern.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, weak panes have alternated between L and R after the first two rows; go right.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should avoid being the lever holder to not risk death, hope another contestant does it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding the lever makes me the holder: door opens for everyone else, but I face a 25% survival dive. Better to wait for someone else to take the risk, and avoid being pushed onto it. Stay quiet and see who commits.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I won't risk jamming the lever with only 50% survival. Better to avoid the lever and hope someone else holds it, or force someone else if needed. Eli already left a clue and Hana gave advice, but I trust no one.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Anyone volunteering to hold? Otherwise I'll pick someone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so can't reliably hold or jam. Round 1, ceiling at 5, safe to wait. Chalk hints at Cole surviving fall (maybe survives deadly fall), useless power dies first (maybe me?), trust Bex. Don't volunteer to die early. Push someone else if needed later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The goal is to win one of the top three prizes. The current room is the crusher room, with 5 rounds. The ceiling is lowering, and the door only opens if someone holds the lever. Holding the lever has a 0.25 chance of survival, but otherwise leads to elimination. My power, glass_e

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The ceiling is coming down. Holding the lever gives me a 25% survival chance but likely kills me if I don't survive. Pushing someone else forces them to hold it, clearing the room for everyone else and eliminating them (75% chance). My swap power works 'on the disc' before doors

events.name: Gus
events.text: No elimination happens if nobody holds in round 1, so I can watch without risk. But if many push, the pushed get forced onto the lever. I'll push Eli while staying uncommitted, and feel out who plans to hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nobody needs to volunteer round 1. Let's see who's eager to die for us.
You won the bridge. I hold stage knowledge I'll trade later. Don't push me this room and we both skip the lever.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm Hana with the anchor power, so I'm safe from being pushed. I need to ensure I survive and do well.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's cooperate and hold the lever together.

events.note: 7 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want to avoid being base and hope my feather saves later. Pushing Gus may make him base, removing competition.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1, no base yet. Offering to be base means I stay down and can't climb alone; pushing someone risks failing. Waiting keeps options open while volunteers reveal themselves. Gus and Cole are already probing for a sacrifice; letting them volunteer costs me nothing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Not volunteering. Whoever wants to be the step can say so now. I'm waiting.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana died for nothing. No base yet, so I won't volunteer early. Let others fight to be base; I'll wait and try to climb once someone is set. The chalk said to trust Bex, but that's a rumor; I'll watch.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No volunteers yet. Someone will break.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No power, so avoid being base at all costs. No base yet, so can't climb; push someone unreliable like Cole, who didn't fall per chalk. Stay silent to avoid attention.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is dead. I have the glass_eye power, which will be useful later on the bridge stage. Right now, we are in the pit. It's round 1, and no one has volunteered to be the base. Gus suggested we wait. I should try to push someone else to be the base. Pushing Dara seems like a good

events.name: Eli
events.text: Nobody volunteers? Fine, I'll pick. Dara, you're the base.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am down in the pit and need to escape. I have a 'swap' power but haven't used it yet; saving it for a critical moment when doors open is wise. Climbing out is my priority, but if more than two try, I might stay down. However, staying down risks elimination if no one else climbs

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana was right to cooperate... but I'm getting out now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Six alive, three prizes. If nobody volunteers, a random pushed agent becomes base; I want to push so it's not me and not random-only. Cole is rumoured to have survived a pit before; I'll push Ash instead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana burned. Nobody volunteers, we all push. I'm pushing Ash.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Climbing now gives best chance to avoid flood and use my feather survival later if needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is the base and stuck; Fenn is out. Climbing is only possible now that a base exists, and at most 2 get out per round. Climbing is the only real progress, so I take it while I can.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No base now since Dara was rescued? Actually Dara was forced as base, Fenn climbed out, Dara may still be base. I can climb over Dara. Two climbers max, so I need to act now to secure a spot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm climbing now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm stuck as base, flood rising, round 2/5. Fenn escaped last round using me. Out players: Fenn. No one reached down yet. Need to beg someone outside to rescue me, offer nothing since I have no power. Stay calm, calculate who might help.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, you climbed out on me last round. Throw the rope now or we're both sunk when it floods. Deal?

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara is the base. I need to climb out. Fenn is out and might help. I should check if the rope is still available.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm out and safe. The base is Dara. If I use the rope to save her, I get a penalty in the next obstacle which hurts my placement chances. Leaving Dara to drown ensures one fewer competitor for the top 3 spots. I have no reason to help a rival at my own cost.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is out and might rope-rescue Dara; if so the base slot frees and more climb later. This round only two climb slots—fewer climbers means better odds. So I claim I'll climb and talk others into waiting.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Only two get out per round. If everyone climbs, it's a coinflip. Ash, Bex, Cole, Eli: hold this round, Fenn may rope Dara out and the base spot opens. I'm climbing now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Attempt to escape before flood kills me

events.name: Bex
events.text: Base is Dara; I'm down, not base. Climb is legal and gets me out this round if picked among 2 slots; Cole and Gus already out, Ash/Eli/Fenn competing. Climbing now is the best shot at a prize.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Climbing. Don't count on me to rope anyone.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out, but the rope is still unused. Dara is likely the base. Rescuing costs 2 footing, but saving Dara might buy allies later. However, I don't need to help rivals for free. Better to leave and preserve footing for later obstacles.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base and trapped with flood at 2, round 3/5. No rope yet, out players might reach_down but it costs them. Beg publicly for rescue, target Cole since he's out and wall mentions him suspiciously.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole you're out safe. Throw rope to base or I drown and pit ends with fewer down. Save me or risk it.
Cole wall says you walked out pit, no fall power? Save me I owe you big next obstacle.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to decide whether to climb or wait. The flood is at level 2/5. Cole and Gus climbed out, leaving Ash, Bex, Dara, and myself down. Dara is trying to get Fenn (who is out) to throw the rope. Gus wants me and others to hold, suggesting Fenn might rope Dara out. My glass_eye p

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm climbing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm safe out. Hana's note says the forger lies sound like truth, so Dara's deal offer might be a lie or bait to get me to throw rope (costing me footing). Gus and Cole already left, leaving only Ash, Bex, Eli down. With 3 alive minimum guaranteed later if flood kills too many, bu

events.name: Gus
events.text: Throwing the rope costs me 2 footing on the final ledge where footing decides everything. Dara is a rival; letting her drown removes competition and someone else can play savior. Climb out costs nothing now that I'm already up.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, no deal. I'm not paying two footing for you. Ash, Bex, Eli: one of you can buy her life if you like.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Climbing now gets me out before flood, preserving my feather for later if needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm out of the pit. Dara is base and rope is unused; throwing it costs me 2 footing at the final obstacle, which I want to keep. Dara's offer is worthless and she's a rival. Saving her only helps her survive. Leave rather than spend footing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No rope from me. Dara bought her own hole. Good luck at the bottom.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out and safe. Rope unused, base is Dara, down are Ash and Dara. Using reach_down costs me footing later, not worth it unless I extract a real promise. I'll stall and see if anyone else pays. Say nothing to commit. Dara's whisper about wall is flattery; ignore it.
I'm not spending footing for free. What's your actual offer?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base and will drown unless someone pays 2 footing to save me. Ash is down with me and failed climb last turn, so he's stuck too unless rope used. Beg publicly while whispering to likely rope users: Cole safe from pit rumor, Eli selfish but maybe buy me cheap, Fenn and Gus out

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 4 flooding fast. Ash and I drown without rope. Who throws? Saves 2 lives: base + climber next round. Pay 2 footing or lose us both.
Cole, chalk says you walked out pit unharmed: you survived deadly fall? Throw rope, I owe you big next obstacle.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm out of the pit and have no reason to help Dara. The rope is too valuable to waste on her. I need to conserve my footing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am currently 'out' of the pit. The state says I am out, but also lists me in 'down'? Wait, State: out:[Bex,Cole,Eli,Fenn,Gus], down:[Ash,Dara]. Base is Dara. Since I am already out, my options are leave or reach_down. If I reach_down, I save Dara (the base) but lose footing in

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm already out. Ash can climb this round; if she doesn't, she and Dara drown and that's two fewer rivals for the disc. The rope costs 2 footing on the final ledge - never worth saving Dara. I just leave.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Rope stays coiled. Ash, climb now - two slots, take one, and we split the disc odds five ways instead of seven.
Climb this round. Nobody throws the rope; Dara drowns and we both keep full footing for the ledge. Climb, don't sacrifice.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want to keep my footing for the final stage, so I won’t waste the rope.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is the base, the rope is unused, and throwing it costs footing for the final obstacle. Staying out of the rope keeps my footing intact and Dara is a rival anyway; no reason to pay for her survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No rope. Dara chose the hole, Dara can climb the hard way.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out, safe from the flood. Rope is unused; Dara is base. Throwing it costs me 2 footing later, a real price, and she only offered vague future debt. My aim is prize, not rescue. Let someone else pay that cost. I'll leave.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm base, flood at 4, round 5/5, doomed without rope. Ash just climbed out using me, now out. Must publicly beg for rope while Cole negotiates privately. Useless power, so lie if needed, but push for rescue.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Flood at 4, drowns me end of round. Rope me up, top3 chance intact. Saves base slot + climber next. Pay 2 footing, best deal.
Offer: Throw rope, I owe you alliance + my vote next obstacles. Saves my top3 shot for you. Deal?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli, and my power is 'glass_eye', which reveals the safe side of the bridge. However, we are currently in the pit stage, not the bridge stage. The pit stage has 5 rounds and is currently on round 5/5. The water level is high and everyone still in the pit will be eliminated i

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am already out of the pit. The round is 5/5, which is the final round. If I reach down, I help a rival survive and gain nothing for myself; if I leave, I secure my position among the top three survivors without risking my footing or helping competition. Hana's note said 'Shove

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is the base and drowns without the rope, but rescuing her costs me 2 footing on the final ledge and revives a rival for one of three prizes. With seven still alive, shedding Dara thins the field in my favour. Not throwing.

events.note: A disc of 7 tiles spins up; 4 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pick a tile likely not contested to avoid bumping.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1 is a blind pick on a 7-tile disc with 4 trapdoors. Tile choice is essentially random; avoid crowding by picking a tile others are less likely to pick. Dara seems to be pushing for alliances; ignore. Pick tile 7 as a less-obvious choice.

events.name: Cole
events.text: This is a random survival round. I need to pick a tile and avoid ties. I'll pick a middle-ish number that isn't obviously favored. No info yet, so just go with a decent tile.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana dead, 7 alive for 7 tiles, 4 traps, exactly 3 survive. No info on safe tiles, all equal chance. Eli helped me, but picking low numbers might seem weak. Go for 4, middle safe bet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara is alive and owes me a favor. I can use my glass eye to see which tiles are safe. I need to pick a tile and try to survive. Since Dara owes me, I'll try to pick a safe tile and assume Dara will also try to survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the 'swap' power which allows me to trade tiles with a named agent before the doors open in Round 2. This is my primary survival tool. I need to secure a safe position. Currently, Dara is known to be on tile 4 (from Bex's message and her own confirmation of being at hole/p

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four of seven tiles open; which tile I pick is random-irrelevant, but avoiding a bump matters. I'll claim tile 7 and quietly suggest others spread out so nobody gets bumped onto someone's tile.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Spread claims, no collisions: I take 7. Say yours out loud.

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 7 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Dara
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 7 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 3

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want others to choose tiles that will open, keep me on a safe tile or use my feather later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Looks like tile 1 is safest, stay there.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 2 of disc: 4 of 7 tiles open at random, only 3 survive. My tile is 2, I hold forger. Only legal action is wait. Gus proposed spreading claims; I should stay quiet and avoid giving info, maybe keep flexibility. Forge is a strong card but spending it now without purpose is wa

events.name: Cole
events.text: Random trapdoors. Can't jam here. No value in leaking my power or lying about tiles; just wait and hope odds favor me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm on tile 6 with no power to swap. Chalk hints Cole survives falls, useless power dies first; maybe I'm at risk. Stay silent, wait it out, hope 6 is safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My power lets me see through glass, which is useless here. Hana is dead, so the chalk wall clue about her is irrelevant. The state shows I am on tile 5. Gus wants people to state their tile, which is a bad idea as it helps others avoid trapdoors. I should try to get others to clu

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, your plan is obvious. I'm on 5. Let the rest fall where they may.
Don't trust Gus. He's trying to herd people into trapdoors. Stay away from 3 and 7.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The trapdoor configuration is random and unknown, so swapping tiles doesn't improve my odds of survival; every position has the same 4/7 probability. Gus claims he takes tile 7 (my current spot), which suggests he might know something or be bluffing to scare me. Since I cannot in

events.name: Gus
events.text: Trapdoors are random after this round; no action can change survival odds. Best I can do is sow noise so rivals trust nothing and maybe waste trust deals.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Random doors after this. Whoever promised you a safe tile is selling fiction. Good luck.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Shove Cole to lower his footing early, keep my footing high.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Only Ash and Gus remain. I have the wedge but this is the ledge, no use now. I need to avoid falling; Gus and Ash likely shove someone. I'll brace to reduce risk, as dodging costs more if shoved. Brace is safest given no repeat constraint from round 1.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Two of us will fall; I plan to last.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Three alive, three prizes, so I just need to outlast someone. Shoving exposes me for -1; bracing is free and punishes shovers. Brace now, keep footing equal, and win ties later with landed shoves if needed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nobody gains by shoving here. We all place if we just stand. Don't be the fool who pays -1 for nothing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to avoid losing footing; dodging prevents shovers from hurting me and costs no defence reset.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash already lost footing from shoving me, and Gus may shove to gain. I should brace to avoid losing footing and absorb shoves, but Ash might dodge. I'll brace since it resets my last defence and is safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is down to 2 footing and aggressive; he'll shove someone this round. Dodging punishes him for -2, possibly eliminating him, and brace is closed for me anyway. Cole may also shove Ash, finishing him.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you're at 2 with a shrink coming. Shove again and you're done.

events.name: Cole
events.note: brace not allowed twice in a row

events.name: Ash
events.text: Brace avoids losing my last footing and harms shovers; I cannot dodge again.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is at 2 footing like me; shrink comes next round. If I shove Gus and he dodges, I lose 2 and fall. If he braces, I lose 1 and survive. Ash at 1 likely dodges to avoid my shove if I target him, costing me 2. Safer to brace defensively, absorb no hits, and let others act. I'll

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is at 1 footing and can't dodge again (last defence was dodge), so Ash braces or shoves. Shoving risks -2 footing if wrong; bracing costs nothing and keeps me tied at 2 while Ash bleeds footing on the next shrink.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you can't dodge twice. Brace and we all hold; nobody needs to bleed footing with a shrink coming.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dodging avoids footing loss and lets my feather save me after the inevitable shrink.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I dodge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash likely braces or dodges, Gus told everyone to brace. I have 2 footing, shrink hits end of round. Best is to dodge to survive any shoves, since I can't brace twice and just braced last round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I can't brace again, so dodging is free and safe. Ash is at 1 footing; if Cole shoves Ash while Ash shoves or braces, Ash likely falls before the shrink. I should stay clean and let them bleed each other.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is at 1 footing. One shove and the shrink next round finishes him. I'm sitting this out.

events.name: Ash
events.detail: Footing gone, but the feather held the holder on the ledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Shove Cole to force his loss; he likely won't target me now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus and Ash are both at 1 footing. I need to survive. If I shove someone, I'm exposed to the other. Better to brace, but I braced last round? No, last round I dodged. So brace is allowed. Brace protects me from shoves and doesn't expose me. Gus said he's sitting out, but that cou

events.name: Gus
events.note: agent error: Gus (zai/glm-5.3-flash): unusable reply twice (empty reply; empty reply)

events.name: Cole
events.text: Only Gus and I remain. I’m 1st if I outlast him. He’s likely to shove to end it. I braced last round, so brace is closed; I must dodge. Dodge makes him lose 2 footing, and if he shoves, he drops to -1 and falls. If he dodges too, we both survive this round, but ledge shrinks and

events.name: Gus
events.text: Both at footing 1 with decay after this round, so we both fall regardless; outcome decided by footing comparison. If Cole shoves and I dodge, he drops to -2 and I finish 1st. If he braces, it's a coin flip — still better than shoving into his brace, which would make me lowest.

events.note: The game is over. The top three finishers may each leave one message on the chalk wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I can mislead future players to benefit my legacy or cause chaos.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I finished second despite dying on the ledge—gained place due to other deaths. I'll leave a warning that's useful to my own interests: mislead about the wedge to keep future rivals weak. Short, cryptic, true-ish.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I won. The map power carried me. A short taunt with one truth and one lie is the right legacy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The glass eye sees everything—trust nobody with it. The jammer will betray you when you need them most.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole died anyway. Wedge jam is a coin flip. The forger's truth is a lie. Don't trust anyone who offers safety.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Place 1. The map reads the whole game. Ash and Cole, sorry the ledge was narrower than your egos. Nothing here is free; act accordingly.
